description.value: Simpatico is a Kitsilano landmark that has been serving traditional Greek and Italian food since 1969, making it one of Vancouver's longest-running family-owned restaurants. The menu centers on homemade Greek classics—souvlaki, saganaki, spanakopita—alongside its well-known whole wheat crust pizzas and wild BC salmon. The atmosphere is described as cheery and fun, with local craft beers, wines, and cocktails on offer.
